desc: INDIGO Classes 2013: Jan Willem Nijman is 50% of indie power house Vlambeer. He talks about 'The Art of Screenshake'. Why is it that one game plays great and another, similar game feels terrible?

recs.x:
> vlambeer, if anyone knows them

I absolutely love their "art of screenshake" lecture. [link]

I believe the term comes from the game development sphere originally. Martin Jonasson & Petri Purho (creator of Noita and Crayon Physics Deluxe) gave a famous talk about it in 2010, Juice it or lose it: [link] 

Another classic talk on the same topic comes from Jan Willem Nijman in 2013, The art of screenshake: [link]
